title: Pokemon TCG Pignite 30/217 Ball Ascended Heroes Reverse Holo
descriptionText: The product is a Pignite Reverse Holo Ball Ascended Heroes Pokemon trading card manufactured by Nintendo in 2026. It is part of the Pokémon franchise and was shown in the Pokémon TV show. The card is a collectible single non-sport trading card, featuring the Pignite pokemon in a unique reverse holo design. This product is sure to be a valuable addition to any Pokémon card collection for fans and collectors alike.
